newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Ent. says returns hard to maintain.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Ent. says returns hard to maintain.

text.p: Pacific Enterprises, will have a harder time maintaining returns at its main subsidiary, Southern California Gas Co (SoCal Gas), following a California rate ruling on Wednesday, the company said in a filing to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).

The California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) adopted a "performance-based" rate regulation for the natural gas utility which calls for stiff cost cuts and sharing of earnings between ratepayers and shareholders.
In its filing, made late Wednesday, Pacific Enterprises said it intends "to control operating expenses and investment within the amounts authorized to be collected in rates."
